plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring reliable damage, improved block, discard for Beckon, and defensive potions. Preserve HP and cover vulnerable attacks; avoid wasting burst during intangible turns.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison scaling and stronger defense. Take elites only after securing attacks and potions. Remove Strikes as damage improves; balance upgrades with survival.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity, efficient block, and weak
plan.bossPrep: Improve block and weak coverage, upgrade poison when safe, carry defensive potions, discard Beckon, and avoid spending damage bursts during intangible turns.
plan.summary: Heal before the forced elite. Existing poison needs stronger defense and faster cycling, not more basic attacks. Seek poison acceleration, remove inefficient cards, and upgrade Flask or Deadly Poison only when survival permits.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling protected by dexterity, efficient block, and weak
plan.bossPrep: Restore health, strengthen block and weak, carry defensive potions, discard Beckon, and save damage bursts for turns without intangible.
plan.summary: Survive the forced hallway using the potion if necessary. Heal at upcoming fires and visit the shop for Meal Ticket recovery. Add defensive cycling and poison acceleration; remove Knife Trap before Strikes.
